{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABUZ5Oig", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzg97lnc", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 15, "title": "Set up GitHub Pages deployment for the Web playground", "body": "## Problem

We want to develop the next iteration Web-first and be able to test the latest state from a mobile phone or any browser while away from a Mac.

There is currently no Web deployment environment.

## Expected outcome

Create the smallest possible GitHub Pages deployment setup so the latest Web playground can be opened from a browser after changes are merged to `main`.

This Issue is only about deployment infrastructure and a placeholder page. It should **not** choose or implement the Speech-to-Text technology stack yet.

## Scope

Add:

- a minimal static Web entry point, such as a simple `index.html`;
- a GitHub Actions workflow that deploys the Web content to GitHub Pages;
- any minimal repository configuration required for Pages deployment.

The placeholder page can contain only a project title and a short message confirming that the Web playground is deployed.

## Deployment behavior

The intended flow is:

```text
merge / push to main
        ↓
GitHub Actions
        ↓
GitHub Pages deployment
        ↓
open latest playground from desktop or mobile browser
```

The expected public location is the repository's GitHub Pages site, for example:

```text
https://takahirox.github.io/my-audio-to-text/
```

Use the repository's actual Pages URL/configuration if GitHub provides a different canonical URL.

## Design constraints

- Keep this implementation intentionally minimal.
- Do not introduce React, Vue, Vite, Next.js, or another framework just for this Issue.
- Do not implement microphone capture, ASR, personalization, PWA support, or application UI yet.
- Do not choose Moonshine, sherpa-onnx, Whisper, or any other ASR backend in this Issue.
- Avoid speculative build tooling. Plain static HTML is sufficient unless Pages deployment technically requires more.
- Backward compatibility with the previous prototype is not required.

## Validation

Verify that:

1. the deployment workflow succeeds on `main`;
2. the published URL is reachable over HTTPS;
3. the placeholder page renders on a desktop browser;
4. the same URL can be opened from a mobile browser;
5. a subsequent change merged to `main` is reflected after redeployment.

## Definition of done

- GitHub Pages is configured for this repository.
- A minimal placeholder Web page is published.
- Changes to the Web content on `main` are automatically deployed.
- The public Pages URL is documented in the README or another obvious repository location.
- No Speech-to-Text implementation or Web framework decision is included in this Issue.
